title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture
title_original: 차산업 발전 및 차문화 진흥에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Enforcement Decree of the Act on Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Types of Tea)
"Those prescribed by Presidential Decree" in subparagraph 1 of Article 2 of the Act on Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means any of the following:
1. Green tea (meaning tea manufactured by roasting or steaming the leaves of tea plants);
2. Black tea (meaning tea manufactured by fermenting the leaves of tea plants);
3. Tea manufactured by mixing the leaves, etc. of tea plants with grains or other ingredients;
4. Other tea manufactured using the leaves, fruits, flowers, etc. of tea plants by methods other than those prescribed in subparagraph 1 or 2.

Article 3 (Scope of Persons Engaged in the Tea Industry)
"Persons prescribed by Presidential Decree" in subparagraph 3 of Article 2 of the Act means any of the following persons:
1. A person engaged in the business of cultivating tea plants or harvesting the leaves, etc. of tea plants;
2. A person engaged in the business of processing, manufacturing, or preparing tea;
3. A person engaged in the business of packaging, storing, transporting, or selling processed, manufactured, or prepared tea;
4. Any other person engaged in research and technological development for the development of the tea industry and the promotion of the use of tea.

Article 4 (Formulation of Master Plans)
(1) "Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 5 (2) 7 of the Act means the following matters: <Amended on September 9, 2025>
1. Matters concerning education and training for disseminating and imparting technologies related to the tea industry and tea culture;
2. Matters concerning the development of cultivars suitable for improving tea quality and mechanizing tea cultivation and production;
3. Matters concerning the development of new uses for tea, including the development of processed tea products and the utilization of beneficial components of tea;
4. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the development of the tea industry and the promotion of tea culture.
(2) "Important matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in the latter part of Article 5 (3) of the Act means the matters specified in Article 5 (2) 1 and 3 of the Act. <Added on September 9, 2025>

Article 5 (Criteria for Designation of Education and Training Institutions)
(1) An institution or organization seeking designation as an education and training institution under Article 8 (2) of the Act shall meet the designation criteria set forth in attached Table 1.
(2) An institution or organization seeking designation as an education and training institution under Article 8 (2) of the Act shall submit an application for designation prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, accompanied by the documents prescribed by Ordinance of that Ministry.
(3) Upon receiving an application for designation under paragraph (2), the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall designate education and training institutions, taking into consideration their compliance with the designation criteria under paragraph (1), the demand for education in each region, and other relevant factors.
(4) Where the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs designates an education and training institution pursuant to paragraph (3), the Minister shall issue a certificate of designation prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
(5) The criteria for revoking the designation of education and training institutions and suspending their operations under Article 8 (4) of the Act shall be as set forth in attached Table 2.
(6) Where the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs designates an education and training institution pursuant to Article 8 (2) of the Act, or revokes its designation or orders the suspension of its operations pursuant to Article 8 (4) of the Act, the Minister shall post that fact on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
(7) Matters necessary for the designation, operation, etc. of education and training institutions, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (6), shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

Article 6 (Standards for Designating Institutions for Training Professional Personnel, Etc.)
(1) Pursuant to Article 9(2) of the Act, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may designate as an institution for training professional personnel an institution or organization that meets the designation standards in attached Table 3 from among the institutions or organizations falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended 2022.2.17>
1. A school that establishes and operates a curriculum related to the tea industry or tea culture, among the schools under the subparagraphs of Article 2 of the Higher Education Act;
2. An affiliated research institute established at a school under the subparagraphs of Article 2 of the Higher Education Act that conducts research on the tea industry or tea culture;
3. A government-funded research institution established pursuant to Article 8 of the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Science and Technology Research Institutes that conducts research on the tea industry or tea culture;
4. A public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions that is related to the tea industry or tea culture;
5. A nonprofit corporation related to the tea industry or tea culture, among the nonprofit corporations established pursuant to Article 32 of the Civil Act;
6. A vocational skills development training facility under subparagraph 3 of Article 2 of the National Lifelong Vocational Skills Development Act that is related to the tea industry or tea culture.
(2) A person seeking designation as an institution for training professional personnel pursuant to paragraph (1) shall submit to the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs an application for designation in the form prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, accompanied by the documents prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
(3) Where the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs designates an institution for training professional personnel pursuant to Article 9(2) of the Act, the Minister shall issue a certificate of designation in the form prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
(4) The standards for revocation of the designation of an institution for training professional personnel and suspension of its operations under Article 9(4) of the Act shall be as specified in attached Table 4.
(5) Where the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs designates an institution for training professional personnel pursuant to Article 9(2) of the Act, or revokes the designation of an institution for training professional personnel or issues an order suspending its operations pursuant to Article 9(4) of the Act, the Minister shall post that fact on the website of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.
(6) Matters necessary for the designation and operation, etc. of institutions for training professional personnel, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (5), shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.

Article 7 (Persons Eligible for Support for Management Stability, Etc.)
(1) Persons eligible for support for management stability under Article 11(1) of the Act shall be persons who cultivate tea and fall under any of the following subparagraphs:
1. Farmers falling under subparagraphs 1 and 2 of Article 3(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Agriculture, Rural Community and Food Industry;
2. Farming association corporations established pursuant to Article 16(1) of the Act on Fostering and Supporting Agricultural and Fisheries Business Entities and agricultural companies established pursuant to Article 19(1) of the same Act.
(2) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, a Special Metropolitan City Mayor, a Metropolitan City Mayor, a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, a provincial governor, or a Special Self-Governing Province Governor (hereinafter referred to as a "Mayor/Provincial Governor"), or a mayor, county head, or district head (meaning the head of an autonomous district; hereinafter the same shall apply) may provide persons eligible for support under paragraph (1) with necessary support for the following matters:
1. Improvement of production infrastructure on tea cultivation land;
2. Improvement of farm roads on tea cultivation land;
3. Installation of disaster prevention facilities on tea cultivation land;
4. Other matters related to tea cultivation, processing, distribution, etc. for which the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, a Mayor/Provincial Governor, or a mayor, county head, or district head deems support necessary for management stability.
(3) Details necessary for support for the management stability of farmers cultivating tea, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2), shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, a Mayor/Provincial Governor, or a mayor, county head, or district head.

Article 8 (Support for Globalization, Etc.)
(1) Pursuant to Article 15 of the Act, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, a Mayor/Provincial Governor, or a mayor, county head, or district head may provide support necessary for an individual or organization that promotes tea and tea culture or develops overseas markets to carry out a project falling under any of the following subparagraphs. In such cases, projects other than the promotion of tea culture shall be supported by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, and projects concerning the promotion of tea culture shall be supported by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism.
1. Education, publicity, survey, and research projects to promote tea and tea culture or develop overseas markets;
2. Projects to organize or participate in tea fairs, exhibitions and sales events, etc. in Korea and abroad;
3. Projects to process or manufacture tea for export, tea-related products, etc. to enhance the export competitiveness of tea and promote entry into overseas markets;
4. Other projects that the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, a Mayor/Provincial Governor, or a mayor, county head, or district head deems necessary to promote tea and tea culture or develop overseas markets.
(2) Details necessary for support, etc. under paragraph (1) shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, a Mayor/Provincial Governor, or a mayor, county head, or district head.

Article 9 (Support for Promotional Exhibition Halls, Etc.)
Pursuant to Article 18 of the Act, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, a Mayor/Provincial Governor, or a mayor, county head, or district head may provide necessary support where a person who establishes and operates a promotional exhibition hall or cultural experience center carries out any of the following projects. In such cases, promotional exhibition halls shall be supported by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, and cultural experience centers shall be supported by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism.
1. Projects to investigate and uncover aspects of the tea industry, tea culture, etc., and to publicize their excellence;
2. Projects to teach and pass on tea manufacturing methods;
3. Projects to teach and pass on tea culture;
4. Projects linking tea with Korean cuisine;
5. Other projects related to the promotion of the tea industry or tea culture, etc., the revitalization of the tea industry, and traditional manufacturing methods, etc.

Article 10 (Delegation and Entrustment of Authority)

(1) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall delegate the following authority to the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration pursuant to Article 22 (1) of the Act:

1. Research for the cultivation and production of tea under Article 7 (1) 1 of the Act;

2. Technology development to improve the quality of tea under Article 7 (1) 2 of the Act;

3. Research and technology development related to the tea industry under Article 7 (1) 4 of the Act.

(2) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall delegate the following authority to the Director General of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service pursuant to Article 22 (1) of the Act:

1. Designation of education and training institutions under Article 8 (2) of the Act, support for education and training expenses under paragraph (3) of that Article, and revocation of the designation of education and training institutions and orders to suspend their operations under paragraph (4) of that Article;

2. Designation of institutions for training professional personnel under Article 9 (2) of the Act, support for expenses for training professional personnel under paragraph (3) of that Article, and revocation of the designation of institutions for training professional personnel and orders to suspend their operations under paragraph (4) of that Article;

3. Investigations, inspection of documents, requests for testing, and orders to change labeling, etc. under Article 19 (1) of the Act;

4. Conduct of hearings under Article 21 of the Act;

5. Imposition and collection of administrative fines under Article 23 (3) of the Act.

(3) The Director General of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service may, with the approval of the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, redelegate part of the authority delegated pursuant to paragraph (2) to the heads of affiliated agencies and shall publicly notify the fact of any such redelegation.

(4) The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall entrust the following duties to the Korea Food Research Institute under the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Science and Technology Research Institutes, Etc. pursuant to Article 22 (2) of the Act:

1. Development of products using tea under Article 7 (1) 3 of the Act;

2. Research and surveys on processing procedures, etc. that meet the standards of export destination countries to improve the export competitiveness of tea under Article 12 (1) 2 of the Act.

Article 11 Deleted. <2021.3.2>

Article 12 (Criteria for Imposing Administrative Fines)

The criteria for imposing administrative fines under Article 23 (1) and (2) of the Act shall be as specified in attached Table 5.
